basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 21.' and it opens 'Vers. 21. Feceruntque filii Israel ut eis fuerat imperatum. Fratres Joseph apostoli sunt,'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 21. Feceruntque filii Israel ut eis fuerat imperatum. Fratres Joseph apostoli sunt, fratres Christi, Petrus et Paulus et caeteri.
